about: A researcher, a writer and a critic explain to a ten-year-old why the moon has phases. All three run on Anthropic Fast, a paid provider.
how: A chain of three agents on one provider.
learns: The paid provider answers with a good, long text: 17.9 seconds, 1,453 input and 3,619 output tokens, and every call has a price.
watch: The totals in Statistics and the length of each answer. Compare with the twin that runs on a free provider.
